assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.emptyTitle: How can I help you today?
assistant.subtitle: Ask me about your farms, plots, sensors or a plot's irrigation prescription. I look up your data to answer.

tips.title: Tips for better answers
items: Write the plot name as it appears in "My plots".
Ask one question at a time: answers are more accurate.
Actions with a pencil fill in the question so you can complete the plot before sending it.
Under each answer you can expand the data the assistant looked up to check the figures.
If the answers start getting confused, start a "New conversation".
